pr_body:
#### Description
- New Binance brokerage implementation (only **Spot Trading** support for now)

> N.B. The following issues need to be addressed for the implementation to work properly:

- [ ] The `SetAccountCurrency` method is not enabled yet for live trading (#110): 
https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Engine/Setup/BrokerageSetupHandler.cs#L222-L227

- [x] Missing pairs in `EnsureCurrencyDataFeed` for direct conversion to account currency:
we are currently using an incomplete list here:
https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Common/Currencies.cs#L42
we are working on a solution reusing the symbol properties database (#4710)

- [x] Non-tradable currencies (from airdrops/distributions) need to be handled in `EnsureCurrencyDataFeed` (setting the conversion rate to zero without terminating the algorithm)
e.g. `ADD`, `ATD`, `EON`, `EOP`, `MEETONE`

- [ ] Indirect currency conversions:
e.g. for `GAS` currency we only have the `GASBTC` pair, for `USDT` account currency we would need two pairs: 
`GASBTC` and `BTCUSDT`

- [ ] The default benchmark (`SPY`) requires the `USD` currency which is not available

#### Related Issue
Closes #2004
Resubmit of #3511 (thanks @AdalyatNazirov)

#### Motivation and Context
- Largest crypto exchange

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
- Local testing with live algorithm + unit tests

#### Types of changes
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] Refactor (non-breaking change which improves implementation)
- [ ] Performance (non-breaking change which improves performance. Please add associated performance test and results)
- [x] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Non-functional change (xml comments/documentation/etc)

#### Checklist:
- [x] My code follows the code style of this project.
- [x] I have read the **CONTRIBUTING** [document](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] I have added tests to cover my changes. <!--- If not applicable, please explain why -->
- [x] All new and existing tests passed.
- [x] My branch follows the naming convention `bug-<issue#>-<description>` or `feature-<issue#>-<description>`

issue_context.title: [Crypto] Implement Binance Bitcoin Exchange
issue_context.body:
Seeking a complete, tested [Binance](https://www.binance.com) bitcoin exchange implementation for QuantConnect, including the IDQH implementation for streaming binance data.  

1 - IBrokerage interface implementation for Binance. All IBrokerage tests should pass.
2 - IQueueDataHandler interface implementation for Binance streaming data.
3 - If possible IDataDownloader implementation for Lean/ToolBox for Binance API.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)
comments:
Do you happen to have an ETA for this? 
Will using https://github.com/glitch100/BinanceDotNet help the development process?
Is there any progress on this work? I would like to try it if possible.
I found the branch for this feature is [here](https://github.com/Adalyat/Lean/tree/feature-2004/binance-brokerage/Brokerages/Binance) but looks like it is abandoned.
@fhassis basically it's done but some minor changes required. There is also a blocker required Lean core changes that should be merged before binance. I think we can afford that in mid/end of August.

That's great news @Adalyat. For Binance support, are you using direct REST API calls or using any libraries?

Also I noticed there is this post [here](https://www.quantconnect.com/forum/discussion/4423/binance-crypto-trading-module) that a user says he has added Binance support to QuantConnect and operating. Maybe you can get a code review from him too.

I came across this project [ccxt-rest](https://ccxt-rest.io/) a few days ago. It's basically one REST interface to 135+ cryptocurrency exchanges. If we can add it as a broker to QuantConnect we can use all those exchanges.

#3511 

There is a [CCXT C# .NET wrapper](https://github.com/lisa3907/ccxt.net) implementation, of the original [CCXT](https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt), that supports hundreds of exchanges.
It would be interesting to incorporate in Lean, as @omidkrad said.

@joao-neves95 I reviewed the CCXT C# project that you referenced and it seems to be a reimplementation of CCXT rather than a wrapper. It supports only 26 exchanges and doesn't seem to be maintained that well, so I wouldn't recommend it. That said, it is possible to create a C# wrapper over CCXT using [Edge.js](https://github.com/tjanczuk/edge) by running CCXT in Node and exposing its functions in-process to .NET, however, I prefer a microservice approach with [ccxt-rest](https://ccxt-rest.io/).

I've created a separate issue for that https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues/3793
